verdict.rationale: The evidence only documents Make acting as an MCP server, where Claude and ChatGPT are MCP clients calling Make scenarios. Nothing shows Make itself connecting to external MCP servers to use their tools. An automation platform with an AI Agents app could plausibly ship MCP-client support, so the axis applies, but there is no evidence for it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
